policy.baselineMeaning: Technical grandfathering only. A baseline match means the file existed unchanged when this gate was introduced; it is not a claim of copyright ownership, license, model release, trademark permission, or other legal clearance.
policy.newOrModifiedAssetRule: Every new or byte-modified protected media asset must have an explicit approved record with a documented rights basis, source, approver, approval date, and evidence reference before production CI may pass.
